 "content": "def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The background is the most frequent color. A full-width colored row is
    # the divider; draw the finish line immediately below the lowest content.
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    divider_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != bg]
    if not divider_rows:
        return out
    divider = divider_rows[0]
    occupied = [r for r in range(divider + 1, h) if any(v != bg for v in grid[r])]
    if occupied:
        end = max(occupied) + 1
        if end < h and all(v == bg for v in grid[end]):
            out[end] = [8] * w
    return out
"
}
